subject: MdeModulePkg: Remove global usage from ArmFfaSecRxTxMap
reasons: Refactors FF-A Rx/Tx buffer state management across two files rather than applying one clear match-and-replace pattern
Edits are tightly coupled to function-specific control flow, error handling, HOB creation, and unmap cleanup
Only small local repetitions exist (deriving buffer addresses from the allocation HOB), but the commit as a whole is not repetitive at scale
This is closer to a context-dependent redesign than an API migration or collateral evolution
